Derek, sorry about the long message, but this is important.
We are officially two months out from one of the most consequential midterm elections in our nation’s history. [**If that’s all you need to hear, you can use this link to chip in.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2026-gfr?refcode=em_20260903_8939_fr&amount=7&refcode2=8939_22930333_HWSTwX&akid=8939%2E22930333%2EHWSTwX) Otherwise, I hope you’ll stick around for this important update.
**[CHIP IN $7](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2026-gfr?refcode=em_20260903_8939_fr&amount=7&refcode2=8939_22930333_HWSTwX&akid=8939%2E22930333%2EHWSTwX)**
Donald Trump’s presidency has had real, catastrophic impacts on American families. Every day that passes without Democrats in power means more jobs lost, higher costs for household necessities, and more chaos sown in our country.
That’s why our team at the DNC is working day in and day out to defeat MAGA politicians and put a check on Trump’s agenda.

government works for everyone.

Two months to get more volunteers on the ground, more ads on the air, more
supporters registered to vote — and two months left to make sure far-right
conspiracy theorists never get a hold of this seat.

important decision — and I wanted you to be the first to know:

In a swing state like Michigan, we have no clue what the next two months
will look like in this race.

But if past competitive elections are any indication, then we can probably
expect this:

The polls will only show a tighter race.
The spending against us will only increase.
The attack ads will only get more vicious.
The amount of national attention on this race will only escalate.

And all of that means we need resources — and to be honest, they’re

Jocelyn

their heart, and they proudly pledge allegiance to our American flag.We'll teach them:**Freedom Requires Courage.****Great Blessings Require Great Sacrifice.****IN GOD WE TRUST.** And we hope to clean_body: In just one month, we're taking our message straight to the Library of Congress. | | | | September 03, 2026 | | Thursday, September 3, 2026 | Estimated Read Time: 3 Minutes Just The Truth Your No-BS Newsletter Dear Readers, Today's sponsored message comes from BRAVE For Good, which is raising tax-deductible donations to fund "Story Hour Kits" for its October 3 "See You at the Library Day" event, with a goal of reaching 250,000 children nationwide. Thank you for your consideration of our sponsors. The Just The Truth Team Friend,In just one month, we're taking our message straight to the Library of Congress. On September 26, I will kick off this year's "See You at the Library" Story Hours at America's Library in Washington, D.C.Then, just one week later, something truly incredible will happen.Christian parents and grandparents across America will walk into their local public libraries with their children and grandchildren.And in a matter of hours, hundreds of Story Hours will fill children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.This is our chance to bring God's truth into libraries across America and reach an entire generation of children.This year, honoring America's 250th birthday, our ambitious goal is to expand "See You at the Library Day" to reach 250,000 children.And we are just ONE MONTH away. Before then, I need you!The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host "Story Hours" has been overwhelming.But it's going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold "Story Hours" for 250,000 children.And with just over one month left, the clock is running out to fund the Story Hours we need to reach 250,000 children. Friend, America's children need to hear our message because today's "educators" and librarians are radicals!Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could.But today, all that has changed.Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, radical activists have worked to turn our public libraries into vehicles for their values.But we can't just sit back and complain about it. We're countering those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And on October 3, a little boy or girl will stand up at their public library as straight and tall as they possibly can......as their right hand covers their heart, and they proudly pledge allegiance to our American flag.We'll teach them:Freedom Requires Courage.Great Blessings Require Great Sacrifice.IN GOD WE TRUST. And we hope to engrave those lessons on every child's heart at "See You at the Library Day."But first, we have to get the resources into the hands of the parents, grandparents, and patriots who are organizing these Story Hours.Your tax-deductible sponsorship gift helps send a "Story Hour Kit" to volunteers organizing "See You at the Library" events.The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. That's enough to sponsor one entire "Story Hour Kit " yourself.Singlehandedly, you'll be helping us reach approximately 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. But October 3 is getting closer every day.We don't have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA.We have something better:Parents. Grandparents. Christians. Patriots. And people like you who refuse to surrender America's children. have just over one month. And we have 250,000 children we're fighting to reach.Thank you!God Bless You and God Bless America,| In faith and freedom,Dr. Trent Talbot Founder, BRAVE For Good| ---|--- P.S. _**EXHIBIT 1 - JOINT FUNDRAISING NOTICE **_

Team Nunn ("JFC") is a joint fundraising committee composed of Iowans for Zach Nunn ("Campaign"), Call to Service PAC ("LPAC") and NRCC (each, a "Committee," and, collectively, the "Committees"). Any contribution to the JFC permissible under the Federal Election Campaign Act, as amended ("FECA"), from contributors who have not exceeded their applicable federal contribution limits, shall be allocated among the Committees pursuant to FECA and the formula set forth in this Notice.

_**Contributions Made by an Individual or Federal Non-Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Individuals or federal non-multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $322,100. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $7,000, designating up to $3,500 to the primary election and up to $3,500 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3\. NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $44,300 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

_**Contributions Made by a Federal Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $120,000. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $10,000, designating up to $5,000 to the primary election and up to $5,000 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3 .NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $15,000 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5 .NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

Contributions to Team Nunn, or to any participating Committee individually, are not deductible as charitable donations for federal income tax purposes. Contributions from corporations, labor organizations, national banks, federal government contractors, foreign nationals without green cards, and other federally impermissible sources are prohibited. The contributor's signature designates his or her contribution to the elections described above. Contributions that exceed a donor's contribution limit to a participating Committee shall be reallocated to the remaining Committees according to this allocation formula to the extent permitted by FECA. Any contributor may designate his or her contribution to a specific participant Committee to the extent permitted by FECA. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the name, mailing address, occupation, and name of employer of each individual whose aggregate contributions exceed $200 in an election cycle or calendar year, as applicable.

name: Darline Graham
subject: I made him a promise, too
body:
Lindsey promised me things would be okay. I've watched him keep that promise to South Carolina ever since. Now, it’s my turn. |
---

Fellow Patriot,

There's a moment I've never forgotten.

I was 11 when we lost our mom. A little over a year later, we lost our dad, too. Our family business - a pool hall and bar right on Main Street in Central, South Carolina - still needed to be run. And I was wondering what came next.

**HARNED CLAIMS WASHINGTON BELTWAY HOME HER RESIDENCE. SHE DOES NOT QUALIFY FOR STATE SENATE.****NHGOP calls on Harned to apologize to voters and suspend her campaign**
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE****September 3rd, 2026**
---
| | | **CONTACT** karina@nhrsc.com

---
| |

CONCORD, N.H. — The New Hampshire Republican Party today released signed and notarized mortgage documents in which Democratic State Senate candidate Rebecca Harned identified herself as residing in Annandale, Virginia, in October 2025.Harned’s campaign claims that she “returned home to New Hampshire” in 2017. She also swore in her candidate qualification affidavit that she had been domiciled in New Hampshire for the seven years immediately preceding the 2026 election.But Harned’s own documents tell a different story.On October 16, 2025, Harned signed a recorded and notarized mortgage document connected to her purchase of a $1.7 million home in Vail, Colorado. It identifies Harned and her co-borrower as:“currently residing at 4632 Willet Dr., Annandale, Virginia 22003.”The mortgage package identifies the Vail property as subject to a Second Home Rider. Harned represented that she was residing in Virginia while purchasing a second home in Colorado.“Rebecca Harned lied to New Hampshire voters about where she lived,” **said NHGOP Chairman Scott Maltzie.** “Less than one year ago, she signed a notarized mortgage document stating that she was residing in Virginia. Those are her words, her signature and her documents.”Part Second, Article 29 of the New Hampshire Constitution and RSA 655:7 require a State Senator to have been an inhabitant of New Hampshire for the seven years immediately preceding the election. RSA 655:29 requires every State Senate candidate to swear or affirm that the candidate has been domiciled in New Hampshire throughout that period.The evidence shows that Harned does not meet that requirement and does not qualify to represent Senate District 7.“There are two possible explanations. Either Rebecca Harned does not meet the 7-year residency requirement to run for state Senate because she resided in Virginia in 2025, or she lied to her mortgage provider when she purchased a nearly $2 million ski vacation home in Colorado,” stated Maltzie. “In either case, Ms. Harned’s residency scandal leaves the voters with too many unanswered questions - where has she been actually residing for the past decade? How can she afford a $2 million ski chalet on a bureaucrat's salary? How many more multi-million dollar homes does she own in other states? - Her story simply doesn’t add up and she must come clean to the voters or drop out of the race. New Hampshire voters should not be asked to ignore Harned’s own signed documents simply because the truth is politically inconvenient for her campaign.”SUPPORTING DOCUMENTS● Exhibit A: October 16, 2025 recorded Deed of Trust, with signatures● Exhibit B: Documentation of the $1.7 million Vail property purchase and Second Home Rider● Exhibit C: Part Second, Article 29 of the New Hampshire Constitution; RSA 655:7; and RSA 655:29
Exhibit A:
---
|
---
| | Exhibit B:
---
|
---
|
---
|

Exhibit C: **[Art.] 29. Qualifications of Senators.** Provided nevertheless, that no person shall be capable of being elected a senator, who is not of the age of thirty years, and who shall not have been an inhabitant of this state for seven years immediately preceding his election, and at the time thereof he shall be an inhabitant of the district for which he shall be chosen. Should such person, after election, cease to be an inhabitant of the district for which he was chosen, he shall be disqualified to hold said position and a vacancy shall be declared therein.

body:
Bears Ears under siege

| [|
---](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/GnlTsWGl9uJ3o3zlnWuJ8A~~/AAUS1hA~/ye4a605RwJL_hqyZ7wMdM-rvrWzqc1eZ92blIEQvXiNlcihpWm2AjTzmU6t6a-FFqzHcXo6PyqAwisv0syIEs4903qgysx7jFbia7viRvMdKGUWDYvsfHmFKRa7JSCc7)
| | | | Peter, This week, outdoor companies like Patagonia, alongside tribal nations and conservation groups, **filed a massive federal lawsuit against the administration for illegally slashing Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monuments by over 90%.** [**While the lawyers fight this in the courtroom, we need to fight it at the ballot box. Will you chip in $3 today to our rapid-response war chest to help us defend Bears Ears?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/03tCGYi1vyj4wAEIHgc8PA~~/AAUS1hA~/nx-VMD-VZep0KHDPl__rglsiGQz75aarbfQNH1qs1yAmNLwFS0W3vaVWuN1IBP5huJDFTIjho8BHvP-9PEb4zFbzrN47hrMrGqb94exh6z6CT7Gc8winS19QwZL3vVyTaXi6LkIxp_nBdv_4PFLWEDMaTaXYUuuDbPxqcYYoHESdLJWKHZfFBAGaNWXpcFSSujUFPpLEz7eCiHkjVBEE1ByBiReoVsMAZuX5n3V_1lvBSAYnBu4yM4Ue-CdWLSTy) The administration wiped nearly three million acres of your pristine canyons, ancient cliff dwellings, and sacred tribal sites off the map. All because they want to force the secession of federal land so their corporate buddies can extract the natural resources underneath it. They’re doing it to open up some of the most culturally and scientifically significant landscapes in America to oil drilling, uranium mining, and corporate extraction. The proof? Mining executives have already staked at least nine new claims on the exact land that was just stripped of its protection. **The Antiquities Act of 1906 was designed to give presidents the power to protect land, not to unilaterally abolish those protections so billionaire extraction companies can bulldoze our heritage.** The politicians rubber-stamping this corporate giveaway expect you to feel overwhelmed. They think they can just ping-pong these designations back and forth until the American public gets exhausted and stops paying attention. name: Defenders of Wildlife
subject: Heroes in American Conservation: Who is the “Grandmother of the Conservation Movement”?
body:
Meet American Conservation Hero Margaret Murie
Meet American Conservation Hero Margaret Murie
| [](https://support.defenders.org/s/5973422/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
|
---
[](https://support.defenders.org/s/5973423/38SyG9Xl)
---
#
Meet American Conservation Hero Margaret “Mardy” Murie
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_Who is she?_**
Margaret “Mardy” Murie (1902–2003) spent much of her childhood in Alaska. She was the first woman to graduate from the Alaska Agricultural College and School of Mines (now the University of Alaska). She even met her husband Olaus Murie in Alaska.
#
Mardy and Olaus were champions of preserving wilderness areas and their work played a huge part in passing the Wilderness Act. Although Olaus passed away less than a year before, Mardy attended the signing of the Act.
#
She spent much of her late life continuing the work she and Olaus started. She surveyed additional Alaskan land for wilderness areas and used her talents as a writer to advocate for the protection of the beautiful, wild areas around the state.
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_How did Mardy help wildlife?_**
Mardy and Olaus were critical to protecting much of Alaska’s wild lands and animals. They learned during their honeymoon researching caribou that vast undisturbed areas were needed for large animals to thrive.
#
This set the couple on a mission to protect what is now the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge. Mardy even helped double what she and Olaus had helped initially save in size.
#
Defenders of Wildlife is working to protect this very Refuge today from administrative and legislative threats. Developments and massive seismic thumper trucks are already reducing safe habitats for all the refuge’s wild residents.
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_How can you become a conservation hero?_**
Murie’s deep love for Alaska inspired her to study and protect it. You too can take steps to learn about the [**wild habitats, Refuges and animals near your home.**](https://support.defenders.org/s/5973424/38SyG9Xl) Share their stories and take measures to help protect them. You can even [**become a Wildlife Defender**](https://support.defenders.org/s/5973425/38SyG9Xl) and respond to legislative and administrative threats to wildlife in real-time.
#
|
---
###
_A note on our Heroes in American Conservation series: Our country has a long and complex history, populated with high-profile figures whose views may have been complicated or divisive in their time as well as ours. We present these conservationists in the interest of creating a greater understanding of the roots of the American conservation movement, and to inspire you to make your own contribution to ongoing conversations about how we preserve our wild world._
#

Murie’s deep love for Alaska inspired her to study and protect it. You too can take steps to learn about the Share their stories and take measures to help protect them. You can even and respond to legislative and administrative threats to wildlife in real-time. | A note on our Heroes in American Conservation series: Our country has a long and complex history, populated with high-profile figures whose views may have been complicated or divisive in their time as well as ours. We present these conservationists in the interest of creating a greater understanding of the roots of the American conservation movement, and to inspire you to make your own contribution to ongoing conversations about how we preserve our wild world. | | | | | | Defenders of Wildlife 1130 17th Street NW • Washington, DC 20036 * Photo Credit: Wandering Brown Bear © Thomas Bills

Fellow Patriot - I'm going to be straight with you, because that's the only way I know how to do this.

_We just won._ Two elections in two weeks: the special primary, then the runoff.

Grueling doesn't begin to cover it. Every dollar this campaign had went into turning out voters, running ads, and getting our message into every corner of this state.

**And it worked.**

But here's the part nobody tells you on election night: winning a runoff doesn't put a single dollar back in our account. Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes.

**Annie Andrews has $4.1 million.**

She's raised nearly $11 million since she got into this race, from liberal donors across the country. She's had months to build that war chest while we were fighting a two-round primary just to get our name on the November ballot.

clean_body: Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes. | Fellow Patriot - I'm going to be straight with you, because that's the only way I know how to do this. We just won. Two elections in two weeks: the special primary, then the runoff. Grueling doesn't begin to cover it. Every dollar this campaign had went into turning out voters, running ads, and getting our message into every corner of this state. And it worked. But here's the part nobody tells you on election night: winning a runoff doesn't put a single dollar back in our account. Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes. Annie Andrews has $4.1 million. She's raised nearly $11 million since she got into this race, from liberal donors across the country. She's had months to build that war chest while we were fighting a two-round primary just to get our name on the November ballot. Countless conservatives in SC put their trust in me, and I promise to carry forward the conservative agenda for the next six years in the United States Senate. After asking me to run, President Trump stood on stage with me and told you why he trusts me, too. I don't intend to let a bigger bank account decide whether I get to keep that promise. The general election is November 3. That sounds far off. It isn't. It's less than 70 days away. Every week between now and then, Annie Andrews's campaign will be on television, in your mailbox, and on your phone - funded by liberal donors who wanted to defeat Lindsey and now, defeat me. We have to be able to answer that, and right now, we can't. My opponent has a $4 million head start. To catch up and rebuild, I need not only patriots who were with us over the last six weeks, but folks who are stepping up for the first time. Don't let the most radical candidate South Carolina Democrats have nominated buy this seat. Thank you for standing with me, Darline Graham United States Senator P.S. Every donor, whether it's your first donation or you've been with us since day one, tells the Hollywood donors watching this race that South Carolina is still behind us after two hard-fought elections. | | Paid for by Darline Graham Majority Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and composed of Darline for Senate, Fund for America's Future, Security is Strength PAC, and NRSC. 228 S. At PreBorn!, however, a gift of $28 helps provide one life-saving ultrasound

| | | | [](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckU2L3DAMhn-Nc8vgyBknOeSwEHLb0paWHoPiKBmz_sJWZv9-mTIDPe_xfSQekN4_78s7WmfD8Q09jZn3JZfFcmHMXD4t32Kg03HGEs-wLSBB13KopVrQsL3T0mK1jZvZsDEVjU3X9207tAqq24h9M2jTdyhVh3LXzSqvO649dLpv9L5Wdnz45CBVc1VSyYtEAAWoiQbdbOYqWomOMl8ypXN11mBgLB97zIYuJvrKjTfmVIR6EzALmA97t-G4pExrzOGxImB-JgGzuZH5iCcLmDElQldqPDfZgXZeqLkYoaa334_8XYA26BPaIwg1taoBkAL0yX4p8cyGhJpSjiWRYRuO58jTZk8v1EQerXvC_zzWJzT84jEwBRZq-tHVP3_N9esbVR639Gmds0V3opXHQ_bvXv5iRfcR_gYAAP__k_Oh1A)
---
Friend of Life, If someone asked you what $28 could accomplish today, you probably wouldn't think of it as a life-changing amount of money. At PreBorn!, however, a gift of $28 helps provide one life-saving ultrasound, and we've seen God use that simple moment to change the course of countless lives. When a woman walks into one of our Network Clinics, she is often carrying far more than the weight of an unexpected pregnancy. Many have been told there is only one answer to the crisis they're facing. Others arrive convinced they are completely alone. Some have never had anyone slow down long enough to ask how they're really doing. That's why the ultrasound matters so much. For the first time, she has the opportunity to see her baby. She hears the heartbeat. She begins asking questions she hadn't considered before. Instead of making a permanent decision in fear, she is surrounded by compassionate people who take time to listen, answer her questions, offer practical support, and share the hope of Jesus Christ. Those moments save babies. They also change mothers, strengthen families, and open doors for the gospel to be shared. In fact, more than 80% of abortion-vulnerable women choose life after seeing their baby on an ultrasound at a PreBorn! Network Clinic. That's the impact your generosity helps make possible. Today, because of a generous group of friends, every gift made before September 30 will be MATCHED dollar for dollar, up to $100,000. That means your gift can help twice as many women encounter a life-saving ultrasound, compassionate care, and the hope of Jesus Christ when they need it most. We know $28 may not seem like much. But to the next woman who walks through the doors of a PreBorn! Network Clinic searching for hope, it could become the moment that changes everything. Will you make your matched gift today and help provide the next life-saving ultrasound?

An issue a day

| | _With just five days until the primary, I am using each day to discuss an issue I have highlighted on the campaign trail. For Day 5, I am highlighting the need to take bold action to keep our communities safe from gun violence._
* * *
Dear David, I remember exactly where I was when I heard the news of the tragic Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting in 2012. That day, I saw our country in a whole new light. The feeling of shock and outrage that our nation had failed to protect first graders has stuck with me. **[14 years later, our country is still grappling with the fact that hundreds of people die from gun violence every day, and Republicans in Washington refuse to take action. If you’re ready to join me and fight for bold solutions to address gun violence, please pitch in today:](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/8kwKSmft8ddn077iHzFdwQ~~/AAUS1hA~/Jx9QVs7knT9-xA3T-_4DKdleRthJb66A9EcBZNmJILoVrMmKufOFvYcglnkEqHgZHG3EVDakb2zZD6zq5dWEi5va0QTP9u_ApZzW3DG2OrkqSZoVyNdmVarya_-X_pvlDF1U6StRl0GFfcH2_rLYFw~~)** | | [DONATE](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/8kwKSmft8ddn077iHzFdwQ~~/AAUS1hA~/Jx9QVs7knT9-xA3T-_4DKdleRthJb66A9EcBZNmJILoVrMmKufOFvYcglnkEqHgZHG3EVDakb2zZD6zq5dWEi5va0QTP9u_ApZzW3DG2OrkqSZoVyNdmVarya_-X_pvlDF1U6StRl0GFfcH2_rLYFw~~)
---
This issue is too complex to approach from a single angle. We need to address gun violence through both a public health lens and a respect for freedom.
The United States has by far the highest rate of gun violence among developed countries. That’s not an opinion, David. It’s a _fact_.
**Gun safety group Everytown’s research shows that the US gun homicide rate is 26 times that of other high-income countries.**
That means that Americans aren’t just naturally more violent than people who live in other countries, or that this is primarily a mental health issue like Republicans try to claim. **This is a failure of leadership.**
I recently heard from my high school history teacher that we should approach guns the same way we approach cars in the United States: train, license, and register.
We don’t allow people to drive without training, licensing, or registering their vehicle. We should apply that same level of care and accountability to firearms. **This is why I support universal background checks, red flag laws, and the RIFL Act, which holds firearm manufacturers, not taxpayers, responsible for the financial burden of gun-violence-related injuries.**
But we also have to acknowledge that there are countless gun owners out there who _do_ follow the rules. They store their firearms safely, pass their background checks, and treat the responsibility of owning a gun with care.
**That’s why I stand for real action to reduce gun violence, paired with real respect for the rights of law-abiding owners. Not one at the expense of the other.**
**[I’m running to create meaningful and lasting change, and I won’t stop until our communities are safe. clean_body: An issue a day | | | | With just five days until the primary, I am using each day to discuss an issue I have highlighted on the campaign trail. For Day 5, I am highlighting the need to take bold action to keep our communities safe from gun violence. Dear David, I remember exactly where I was when I heard the news of the tragic Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting in 2012. That day, I saw our country in a whole new light. The feeling of shock and outrage that our nation had failed to protect first graders has stuck with me. ~~ | | ~~ This issue is too complex to approach from a single angle. We need to address gun violence through both a public health lens and a respect for freedom. The United States has by far the highest rate of gun violence among developed countries. That’s not an opinion, David. It’s a fact. Gun safety group Everytown’s research shows that the US gun homicide rate is 26 times that of other high-income countries. That means that Americans aren’t just naturally more violent than people who live in other countries, or that this is primarily a mental health issue like Republicans try to claim. This is a failure of leadership. I recently heard from my high school history teacher that we should approach guns the same way we approach cars in the United States: train, license, and register. We don’t allow people to drive without training, licensing, or registering their vehicle. We should apply that same level of care and accountability to firearms. This is why I support universal background checks, red flag laws, and the RIFL Act, which holds firearm manufacturers, not taxpayers, responsible for the financial burden of gun-violence-related injuries. But we also have to acknowledge that there are countless gun owners out there who do follow the rules. They store their firearms safely, pass their background checks, and treat the responsibility of owning a gun with care. That’s why I stand for real action to reduce gun violence, paired with real respect for the rights of law-abiding owners. Not one at the expense of the other. ~~ If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | ~~ My heart is with every individual and family impacted by gun violence, and I can promise you that I won’t stop working until we make meaningful progress on this issue. Thank you. I know I’ve been sending you a lot of emails about my reelection race in Virginia these days, and today, I want to take a step back and reintroduce myself.

[_**But first, I'm hoping you'll consider chipping in to my reelection campaign to protect this must-win Senate seat for Democrats and take back control of Congress.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138497888/644251261/1079622208?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Reintroduction_260903_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTA2MjU1ZS1hY2E3LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTkzM2IiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=88ATui8ILOuTkNLUD0Lr5P3bUiexIvds1I0iXVW8ipw=)

Like so many Americans, I grew up in a middle-class family and was lucky enough to attend good public schools. I have my 8th grade history teacher to thank for setting me on the path to being a Democrat. Before I became a U.S. Senator, I actually started out in business. I invested my entire life savings, a few thousand dollars, into my first venture... which failed in about 6 weeks, by the way. My second venture did a little better, lasting six months, but it wasn’t until my third try that things started to look up. I’m extremely proud to have founded what became one of Virginia’s leading tech companies.

It was actually that experience that got me into public service. I thought that everybody in this country ought to have the same kind of fair shot that I had. So, I ran for governor in Virginia, and won. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138497890/644251263/1079622208?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Reintroduction_260903_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTA2MjU1ZS1hY2E3LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTkzM2IiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=88ATui8ILOuTkNLUD0Lr5P3bUiexIvds1I0iXVW8ipw=) And if you can believe it, my good friend Tim Kaine (now my fellow Virginia senator) was my Lieutenant Governor. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138497891/644251264/1079622208?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Reintroduction_260903_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTA2MjU1ZS1hY2E3LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTkzM2IiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=88ATui8ILOuTkNLUD0Lr5P3bUiexIvds1I0iXVW8ipw=) After our four years in the governor’s office, Virginia was rated the best state for business, the best managed state, _and_ the best state to receive an education. But even then, I knew that my work to make sure that _every_ family – no matter their background – has the same shot that I did, was far from over.

That’s when I ran for the United States Senate, and won. That year, President Obama won in Virginia too – the first time the Commonwealth of Virginia voted for a Democratic presidential nominee since 1964. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138497892/644251265/1079622208?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Reintroduction_260903_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTA2MjU1ZS1hY2E3LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTkzM2IiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=88ATui8ILOuTkNLUD0Lr5P3bUiexIvds1I0iXVW8ipw=) In the Senate, I helped spearhead the largest infrastructure and public lands investments in half a century, worked to significantly expand Virginia’s domestic manufacturing, and have fought to lower health care costs across the Commonwealth. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138497893/644251266/1079622208?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Reintroduction_260903_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTA2MjU1ZS1hY2E3LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTkzM2IiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=88ATui8ILOuTkNLUD0Lr5P3bUiexIvds1I0iXVW8ipw=) **But I have to tell you, in my time in the Senate – maybe in my time in politics – there has been nothing as challenging, as bizarre, and as _holy sugar_ as the second Trump administration.**

This administration's incompetence has made every American less safe. The president’s tariffs and reckless foreign policy have caused prices to skyrocket for working families. His administration is peddling conspiracy theories about our elections and undermining American’s faith in our democracy. And my Republican colleagues continue to fail at holding him accountable.

I didn’t get into politics to let people like Trump dismantle our federal government and rebuild it for himself and his allies. I’m proud to lead the fight against this corrupt administration, but I can’t do it alone.

subject: Voto Latino is combating disinformation
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
We just launched our new disinformation campaign – El Brief.
#
Peter,
In 2020, we saw historic voter turnout. But we also noticed the beginning of a deliberate plan for long-term voter disengagement by bad-faith actors.
Since then, voting rates have decreased, mistrust about our institutions has grown, and millions of Americans — especially young Latinos — have begun feeling like their voices no longer matter.
**This disillusionment comes from coordinated and targeted online disinformation efforts.**
[****](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260903-1.hqa6NB&amount=3&refcode=em20260903-547&t=1&akid=547%2E1366028%2Eh9oM3L)
**This is why we just launched a year-round strategy to address the root causes of disengagement directly.**
Through authentic, community-centered investments and our new digital hub, **El Brief** , we are meeting Gen Z and Millennial Latinos where they already scroll on TikTok, [Instagram](https://act.votolatino.org/go/606?t=2&akid=547%2E1366028%2Eh9oM3L), and YouTube to bust viral myths before they take root.
At the same time, we are running continuous campaigns that expose the harm of extreme policies, testing our messaging in real time, and expanding both paid and organic outreach to re-engage voters long before Election Day.
We know civic trust isn't built overnight, and it requires showing up every single day with the truth, real community investment, and accessible information.
**[Peter, will you pitch in $3 right now to power Voto Latino’s year-round work to fight disinformation and re-engage Latino voters?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260903-1.hqa6NB&amount=3&refcode=em20260903-547&t=3&akid=547%2E1366028%2Eh9oM3L)**

Thank you,
Voto Latino

clean_body: Patriot, You hear it every time you turn on the news... " Donald Trump wants to be King." "Donald Trump is a dictator." "Donald Trump is a Nazi." But actually, it's President Trump's leftist foes who are the true authoritarians. These aren't saviors of democracy. They 're Marxists. Consider Zohran Mamdani, the newest hero of the Left, who pledged in his inaugural address that he would replace individualism with the "warmth of collectivism." And Cea Weaver, whom Mamdani appointed to oversee housing in New York, has said she wants to "transition" away from private property. Increasingly, they proudly call for outright socialism! This is an alarming wake-up call. A warning to Americans across the country to fight for our constitutional rights and our free-market system. Because if the radical left gets their way, these things will be gone forever... I'll never stop defending America, our Constitution, our free market economy, and our Judeo-Christian traditions. And I'll never stop calling out the leftists who want to tear our country down. I know you won't either! I'm doing everything I can to rally our fellow freedom-lovers to the fight, through my books, my radio show, and my TV show. body:
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3095?t=1&akid=5643%2E35263%2EdUbbFC)
Peter,
Nearly _two-thirds_ of Social Security employees report customer service has declined over the past year.
That’s unacceptable, Peter. This leaves nearly 75 million Americans who rely on the program unable to be fully served by the agency. Staffing cuts and reassignments are causing a crisis at these offices.
That’s why I launched an investigation, alongside Senate colleagues, to look into the ongoing decline in service at the agency. Technically shortcuts, lack of staff training, removing experts to answer the national phone line, alarming guidance – these are just a few of the changes that continue to lead to a service decline. We cannot proceed with just band-aid solutions — we need long-term plans to address the slowdown.
Over 100,000 people visit their local SSA office — and these cuts and reassignments have forced seniors and people with disabilities to wait even longer for an appointment. **We need answers.**
I’m committed to fighting for our seniors and people with disabilities to get the benefits they deserve. That’s why I previously introduced legislation to prevent arbitrary field office closures. I’m going to keep pushing not only for answers, but solutions. We deserve that.
Thank you for fighting alongside me,
Tammy

I’m fighting for all of us to receive the benefits we deserve, and I’m working every day to stop the attacks and cuts. **[I need your support to keep up the fight in Congress — if you’re with me, please make a donation to support my campaign.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/6050?c0=em-ms-tb-20260903-socialsecurity.4vQBqV&amount=5&refcode=em20260903-5643&t=2&akid=5643%2E35263%2EdUbbFC)**

I’m committed to fighting for our seniors and people with disabilities to get the benefits they deserve. That’s why I previously introduced legislation to prevent arbitrary field office closures. I’m going to keep pushing not only for answers, but solutions. We deserve that. Thank you for fighting alongside me, Tammy P.S. I’m fighting for all of us to receive the benefits we deserve, and I’m working every day to stop the attacks and cuts.

subject: Tonight's Debate & Opponent's Silence on the SAVE Act
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Paige Beauchemin for Congress
body:
| |
---
Power, Prosperity, Peace
| Friends, Tonight is the night! Tune in to WMUR at 9 p.m. EDT to see Paige take the debate stage with her opponent. This debate couldn’t come at a more pivotal time. We are five days out from the primary election, and our opponent just declined to vote no on a resolution that calls for enactment of the SAVE America Act. The SAVE America Act would impose new documentary proof-of-citizenship requirements for voter registration and new identification requirements for federal elections. The Brennan Center for Justice has called it the [“most restrictive voting bill ever passed by Congress”](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/IkPRb48gj5wmBVuMKC7zCAxLm0q1XuKS/click?signature=49e8f8fe801c8f4bd87c729def45f04787c7a2ff&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.brennancenter.org%2Four-work%2Fanalysis-opinion%2Fnew-save-act-bills-would-still-block-millions-americans-voting). Any politician who says they support voting rights should take every opportunity to stand firmly against it. The resolution, **H. Res. 1490: Providing for the condemnation and denouncement of socialism in all its forms, and for other purposes** , was highly partisan. It also explicitly called for enactment of the SAVE America Act. Here is a direct excerpt from the resolution, which you can read in full [here](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/IkPRb48gj5wmBVuMKC7zCAxLm0q1XuKS/click?signature=a2e2fb20dcaaa2bbce73febb9b55eefccfcc3528&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.congress.gov%2Fbill%2F119th-congress%2Fhouse-resolution%2F1490):
> “That the House of Representatives— (1) condemns and denounces socialism in all its forms, including the Democratic Socialists of America, and opposes the implementation of socialist policies in the United States; (2) reaffirms its support for free, fair, and secure elections; (3) reiterates the notion that American elections are for American citizens only; (4) recommits itself to upholding the Constitution of the United States; and (5) calls for enactment of the SAVE America Act to ensure election security, increase public confidence in America’s voting system, and close loopholes in order to prevent noncitizens from voting in elections.”
While [192 Democrats](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/IkPRb48gj5wmBVuMKC7zCAxLm0q1XuKS/click?signature=f6959c9446d82578d77a5b1daf86e6f0b68cd1a0&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.yahoo.com%2Fnews%2Fpolitics%2Farticles%2Fhouse-adopts-resolution-condemning-socialism-215300861.html) voted against the resolution, Maggie Goodlander voted “[present](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/IkPRb48gj5wmBVuMKC7zCAxLm0q1XuKS/click?signature=19c5af44037f2d69eff0a2d6c61aa3e95b9cc15f&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.congress.gov%2Fbill%2F119th-congress%2Fhouse-resolution%2F1490%2Fall-actions%3Foverview%3Dclosed%26q%3D%257B%2522roll-call-vote%2522%253A%2522all%2522%257D).” She declined to join 192 House Democrats in voting no. Democratic-socialist and progressive candidates are gaining momentum around the country. Leaders like [Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/IkPRb48gj5wmBVuMKC7zCAxLm0q1XuKS/click?signature=db63b0543c60652cda1970bbb0332ef2022aa3f9&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.theguardian.com%2Fus-news%2F2026%2Faug%2F26%2Falexandria-ocasio-cortez-rejoins-dsa) and [Rashida Tlaib](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/IkPRb48gj5wmBVuMKC7zCAxLm0q1XuKS/click?signature=f3fc85846bc39e997213451e6bad416d9df5521f&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdemocraticleft.dsausa.org%2F2026%2F09%2F02%2Ftlaib-responds-to-house-resolution-condemning-socialism%2F) are united around issues like Medicare for All and stronger labor unions. These positions are hardly fringe. Polling shows substantial support for a [ Medicare for All ](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/IkPRb48gj5wmBVuMKC7zCAxLm0q1XuKS/click?signature=42ec4d9d56269361581fadbe17ce4d37cd6e80c3&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.citizen.org%2Farticle%2Fpolls-show-americans-are-ready-for-medicare-for-all%2F)system, while [71% of Americans approve of labor unions](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/IkPRb48gj5wmBVuMKC7zCAxLm0q1XuKS/click?signature=593ed8adfd6e9cb437a6983404cba7f4a6549827&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.gallup.com%2Fpoll%2F713936%2Frecord-high-unions-influence.aspx). Goodlander’s vote also comes just over two months after she signed the [Promise to America](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/IkPRb48gj5wmBVuMKC7zCAxLm0q1XuKS/click?signature=4f509ca57faf0deef1fd95ed147d751cd9b886df&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.thepromisetoamerica.com%2F) pledge, an initiative that has drawn [criticism and concern from progressives](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/IkPRb48gj5wmBVuMKC7zCAxLm0q1XuKS/click?signature=2f290a056298721b72941a9a769584f695c97f8b&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.commondreams.org%2Fnews%2Fpromise-to-america-funders). There is a real choice about the direction Democrats should take. **Tonight is a chance for Paige to highlight her pro-worker positions and advocate for everyday people.** Tonight’s debate is an opportunity to show more Democratic NH-02 voters that they have options on Primary Day. They can choose a candidate who declined to join 192 House Democrats in rejecting this resolution. Or they can choose Paige, who supports Medicare for All, stronger unions, affordable housing and childcare, and policies that make it easier for working people to build a good life. Paige knows firsthand what everyday people are going through, and she is committed to fighting for a country where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. **Here’s How to Watch Tonight’s Debate** 📺 **TV**

| | | Congratulations Democrats. Congratulations to every individual who put themselves out there by putting their name on the ballot – because that alone takes a kind of courage most people never choose to summon. Running for office means opening yourself up to scrutiny, to criticism, to long nights and longer odds, all in service of the belief that you could make things better for your neighbors, from the Berkshires to Cape Cod. Congratulations to the candidates who won, and just as much to those who ran hard and came up short; democracy needs both. Every name on a ballot, in every city and town across this Commonwealth, is a statement that our system still works, that people are still willing to step forward instead of standing back. And congratulations to the organizers who built the infrastructure, the volunteers who knocked doors from Pittsfield to Provincetown, the donors who chipped in what they could, and the voters across all 351 cities and towns who showed up and made their voices heard. None of this happens without all of you. This momentum we’ve created isn't something you bank. It's something you expand on, or it fades away. So Democrats, let’s turn that momentum into organization, organization into action, and action into results people will actually feel in their daily lives. **I hope you’ll join us**[**virtually tonight at 5 p.m. for our Momentum Rally**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138503478/644267597/-157778410?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzgwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZGI3YWFhNy1iMmE3LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTkzM2IiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4NpprN-DIYZBrZqJMY3s4qh5lMjQEV4o2TOhEMc1F60=&emci=a367afea-aea7-f111-9b33-0022482a933b&emdi=ddb7aaa7-b2a7-f111-9b33-0022482a933b&ceid=17281370)**as we keep the energy and grassroots movement going.**

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Democrats cannot win just by being in opposition to Trump.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2499%2E135344%2E1KkMiZ)

Right now, Democrats cannot win just by being in opposition to Trump. They have to actually stand for something.
We need to get back to basics a little bit if we want to bring back voters who may have left our party in recent years. Here's what I stand for as a Midwestern Democrat that favors pragmatism:
An economy where if you work hard and play by the rules, you get ahead, and your kids do better than you did. That is the core of it, and everything else flows from there.
One job that pays you well, with good benefits, where you can save money every month. Not an extra side hustle and still coming up short.
A home you can actually afford. Not waiting until you are fifty to buy your first house. A place you own, where you can raise your family and build equity to pass on to your kids.
Good public schools for our kids, that help train them for the jobs of the future, not the economy of thirty years ago.
Healthcare that is as good as what people get in other wealthy countries, where you do not go bankrupt because you got sick. In my mind, that means a national insurance plan available to anyone at any age. A system that rewards you for taking care of yourself.
And a common set of democratic rules that everyone plays by. No exceptions. No one man or one team can bend the system for themselves while everyone else follows the rules. And in my mind, that shouldn't be partisan.
That is the vision.
Elissa Slotkin

* * *

The outcome of this election will determine whether we are able to put a check on President Trump during the final two years of his term. We have to take back the House and the Senate. And we need your help to get it done.

clean_body: Right now, Democrats cannot win just by being in opposition to Trump. They have to actually stand for something. We need to get back to basics a little bit if we want to bring back voters who may have left our party in recent years. Here's what I stand for as a Midwestern Democrat that favors pragmatism: An economy where if you work hard and play by the rules, you get ahead, and your kids do better than you did. That is the core of it, and everything else flows from there. One job that pays you well, with good benefits, where you can save money every month. Not an extra side hustle and still coming up short. A home you can actually afford. Not waiting until you are fifty to buy your first house. A place you own, where you can raise your family and build equity to pass on to your kids. Good public schools for our kids, that help train them for the jobs of the future, not the economy of thirty years ago. Healthcare that is as good as what people get in other wealthy countries, where you do not go bankrupt because you got sick. In my mind, that means a national insurance plan available to anyone at any age. A system that rewards you for taking care of yourself. And a common set of democratic rules that everyone plays by. No exceptions. No one man or one team can bend the system for themselves while everyone else follows the rules. And in my mind, that shouldn't be partisan. That is the vision. *|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* |
---
| | [](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyc0MFugzAMgOGnCTdQsENaDjlMqrh11x2RSwxYCgkiaae9_USlvcDOtuxP_9d9vJMEicsnbeyWtO_jkUdZ6cWx8EYS2FP8SZHLKjmPoMHWuq81jjQVefFoqPLOkDXW2opde7leTQcG22p19PDmirMGj9A_WgTszDzPgEj-YiZbiTsP6l5ja0FD32APM5i2swY7Y-ykjGYvJR3NaTs4i-dYhEIzpa0Kbi1lzwo_FAwKhszT8-CGIvtUzg0Fw0oh1GmuF6FYsoJhp_qkp6hweJZtnGjbSZao8PaHUWDfkxQLx6Lwdj6vDuf3bwlBsr0oo5ezzptR_hvu5eA3AAD__0w9fdI)
Friend,

Back in the mid 2000s, my organization, Club for Growth, received a call from a guy who wouldn't take no for an answer.

He was mid-forties, selling off part of his business, and looking for a way into public policy. His pitch was terrible, and he'll admit it. Something like, _"I'm selling my business and want to get involved in public policy. Can you use a guy in his mid-forties with marketing expertise?"_

Eventually, he got through to Lynn Bradshaw, my right hand at the Club for Growth.

She connected him to a board member, and before long, he was the President of Americans for Limited Government. He also became a good friend of mine.

His name is John Tillman.

I don't usually go looking for kindred spirits in this business, but John and I clicked fast. We both like arguing for the same thing, **that free enterprise and entrepreneurship make people's lives better** , and we've been working on it together for twenty years now.

If John hadn't made those calls, who knows where he would have ended up? So I'll take some of the credit for what John is doing.

That's why I'm writing you today.

**John founded Hall of Giants.**
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyc0MFugzAMgOGnCTdQsENaDjlMqrh11x2RSwxYCgkiaae9_USlvcDOtuxP_9d9vJMEicsnbeyWtO_jkUdZ6cWx8EYS2FP8SZHLKjmPoMHWuq81jjQVefFoqPLOkDXW2opde7leTQcG22p19PDmirMGj9A_WgTszDzPgEj-YiZbiTsP6l5ja0FD32APM5i2swY7Y-ykjGYvJR3NaTs4i-dYhEIzpa0Kbi1lzwo_FAwKhszT8-CGIvtUzg0Fw0oh1GmuF6FYsoJhp_qkp6hweJZtnGjbSZao8PaHUWDfkxQLx6Lwdj6vDuf3bwlBsr0oo5ezzptR_hvu5eA3AAD__0w9fdI) Hall of Giants will be a first-of-its-kind cultural institution devoted to celebrating America’s entrepreneurial spirit.

It is not a typical museum, and it's not trying to be one.

Think Disneyland's sense of spectacle applied to American economic history.

I've spent thirty years in think tanks and on op-ed pages making the economic case for free enterprise. When John asked me to sit on the Advisory Board, I said yes because Hall of Giants makes the case in a different way, one I think might work better on the people who matter most: the next generation.

**An institution like this doesn't get off the ground on good intentions. It needs people willing to back it now, before most of the country has heard the name.**

Will you join us as an early supporter of this ambitious project?

* Educate the public that private-sector innovation and effort drive societal prosperity

Here's what the data tells me, and I follow this stuff for a living.

Young people haven't turned against enterprise because they studied it and rejected it. Most of them were simply never introduced to it, not as a set of incentives in an economics class, but as a human story of risk, failure, and reward.

That's not because the promise stopped being true. It's because we stopped telling the story well.

That's the gap Hall of Giants exists to close.

body:
Her work changed what was possible for generations of women. |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138503880/644268824/1425818251?refcode=WUEFEU21_20260903_Steinem_PL&sourceid=1059953&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMTliNmQxMS1iM2E3LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTkzM2IiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bZQePTHUMFc08TAHhKvMcRkwrGFtSZKytWgyqxwTZ4o=) Today, I’m mourning Gloria Steinem — a trailblazer who spent her life fighting for women to have an equal voice, an equal say, and equal power. For decades, Gloria’s work and the work we were doing at EMILYs List were part of the same movement: organizing women, expanding our political power, and changing who gets to lead. Gloria understood something I’ve believed since I founded EMILYs List more than 40 years ago: **Women do not have to wait for power to be handed to us. We can build it ourselves.** She changed the way women saw themselves — and the way men saw women. She gave generations of women the confidence to stand up for their rights, while showing millions of men that our families and our communities would be stronger when women were equal partners and participants. Gloria made the case, over and over again, that women’s equality was not a side issue. It was fundamental to the future of our democracy. That fight continues today. I’ve seen firsthand how much can change when women organize, run for office, and demand a seat at the table. And at a moment when our reproductive freedom is under attack and women remain underrepresented at nearly every level of government, that work is as urgent as ever. And there is so much reason to keep going: Across the country, Democratic pro-choice women are stepping forward to run, lead, and fight for a future in which women have an equal say in the decisions that shape our lives. **By supporting our work, and those women, you help carry Gloria’s legacy forward.** Thank you for being a part of this movement. Ellen R. Malcolm
Founder and Chair Emerita, EMILYs List

For decades, Gloria’s work and the work we were doing at EMILYs List were part of the same movement: organizing women, expanding our political power, and changing who gets to lead. Gloria understood something I’ve believed since I founded EMILYs List more than 40 years ago: Women do not have to wait for power to be handed to us. We can build it ourselves. She changed the way women saw themselves — and the way men saw women. She gave generations of women the confidence to stand up for their rights, while showing millions of men that our families and our communities would be stronger when women were equal partners and participants. Gloria made the case, over and over again, that women’s equality was not a side issue. It was fundamental to the future of our democracy. That fight continues today. I’ve seen firsthand how much can change when women organize, run for office, and demand a seat at the table. And at a moment when our reproductive freedom is under attack and women remain underrepresented at nearly every level of government, that work is as urgent as ever. And there is so much reason to keep going: Across the country, Democratic pro-choice women are stepping forward to run, lead, and fight for a future in which women have an equal say in the decisions that shape our lives. By supporting our work, and those women, you help carry Gloria’s legacy forward. Thank you for being a part of this movement. Ellen R. Malcolm Founder and Chair Emerita, EMILYs List EMILYs List is committed to electing Democratic pro-choice women at every level of government and building a future where women have an equal say in the decisions that shape our lives. | =** | = | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Thank you for being a supporter of EMILYs List.
